reviews.text: A completely irresponsible act.

The price estimates are completely off the mark. A female dog developed a uterine infection and had to have her uterus removed, the price estimate was “around €1000”. Fortunately, the dog’s surgery went well and she is alive, but the price estimate was incorrect and the bill came to over €3000.
Removing the uterus due to uterine infection is (unfortunately) a very common procedure at a vet, so you would think they would know how to give a correct price estimate. They probably don’t give the correct price on purpose so that the customer doesn’t choose another vet.
So when the vet recommends some additional things, don’t agree. They never give prices and don’t offer them in the name of the pet’s well-being, they just want to make money. Just say “just an operation, nothing else or extra, thank you”.
+ Good service, -expensive prices.
Really good and professional service. Warm and caring staff ❤️
A really good first experience and we will definitely do business with you in the future!
The service is good and the staff is too 🤗 …
We went to the eye doctor with our dog Vili today. Veterinarian Lotta Liimatainen provided first-class care and was also very warm-hearted. I highly recommend her.

The service was good and friendly, we apologized for the rush, but everything went great and the schedule worked well. Thank you to the nursing staff
T.satisfied customer

We have been going to Meveti with our dog for some time now, but our last visit confirmed that this is definitely a hospital we will continue to visit. Our dog was in a life-threatening condition and we rushed straight from home to the emergency room, where the friendly and attentive staff immediately greeted us. The veterinarians and nurses were very professional and were able to stabilize the dog quickly, even though the situation was not easy. The surgeon who performed the operation was first-class! I am truly grateful that I was kept so well informed of the situation by all the doctors. The reception staff at Meveti is always friendly and very compassionate. We left Meveti for further treatment at Espoo Animal Hospital, as the dog needed a blood transfusion, but I am extremely grateful for the truly excellent service that Meveti offered us this time as well. Valo's owner thanks you!
Milli and Teppo received the best care ❤️
Very good experience, but the expensive price of the emergency number made me drop one star
Visited twice, both times came back with a dead dog and the bill was over 3000e I do not recommend it to anyone
Good but expensive

wonderful and respectful behavior after our cat passed away.
We were able to say goodbye peacefully in our own room and as a souvenir, we left paw prints on a card.
Warm thanks and high recommendation ♥️
Empathetic service
Good service
We visited a familiar doctor. The service here has always been friendly. Even after Evidensia bought the mevet.
Phone service is just cash, 3 min wait (7eur) and then the call is over
Customer-friendly and professional service. Especially when compared to veterinary clinics operating in the Myyrmäki area.
Prejudicial and disrespectful behavior towards our dog and my wife. Will not visit again - ever.
The veterinary services themselves are great, but I just got a sales call from Evidensia. Telemarketing is really off-putting and I don't want to do business with a company that does that.

Went there twice (cause of Xmas holidays no other cat vet clinics had available times) since our cat had constipation issues and both experiences have been really bad. In the first visit they had a X-ray done to see how the cat tummy’s looked like and they had an enema done. They didnt X-ray our cat after the enema was done to know was everything removed with the enema or not, and we found out about that only in the second appointment 4 days later with another vet. They wanted to charge us for another x ray in the second visit. They asked for full blood work check AGAIN. We stayed 4h waiting until my boyfriend asked the receptionist what is going on. Our cat stayed there 12h and came back home having diarrhea non stop for 12h afterwards. I followed instructions about medications and food care and now it’s been almost a week since second visit and the cat is still constipated. They try to rip you off anyway they can, especially with their ER service since they can make you wait hours in the evenings to charge you from 25%-60% more. We have spent with them about 1200€ or more and in the meantime our cat is STILL dealing with same constipation. They agree one price with you and try to charge something else later unless you fight for it. Reception was rude, and you can’t trust the vets.

I don’t recommend this place to anyone.

They just want to rip your money off you and keep your pets sick so you’ll come back there again. They don’t care about your pet.

⚠️ KEEP YOUR PET AWAY FROM THIS PLACE! ⚠️
Friendly and knowledgeable veterinary clinic.

Really professional service and the customer's wishes were taken into account very well.
After the procedure, clear feedback was given in a nice, quiet space about what was done and how things went.

Disappointing clinic and extremely overpriced for the low quality of services they provide.
Went for a simple skin infection of my dog and was charged around 400€, because half of it was for a “dermatologist” that we never actually asked for OR EVEN saw. The vet was just a “normal” vet, not dermatologist.
The prescribed medicine was actually for cats (I was allowed to give it to my dog), but the vet didn’t write any note on the prescription for the pharmacist to know this is okay, so there was also a huge confusion while picking up the medicine.
Would not recommend and will not go back to the clinic again.
The place is really clean and spacious. Customers are well taken care of. The only thing is the waiting time in the emergency room is too long!

My cat had a type 2 leg fracture, and surgeon David recommended a complex procedure with external fixators as an alternative to amputation. The surgery went incredibly well, David did an amazing job. Three months later, she’s running and jumping just like before. Her leg is fully functional again, and she’s completely pain-free. Medically, it’s a 5/5.
However, the communication about payments and total costs could be clearer. My wife is a Finnish citizen, and even she struggled to get a straightforward estimate.
But overall, if it’s anything medical, just ask for David, he’ll take care of it.

The unqalified vet suggested to perform !an urgent ! diagnostic surgery for my 5 month old kitten bc she could not read the ultrasound correctly. 10 hours in that so called clinic, 750 euros gone, some gray hairs gained. Took 30 mins and 200e  for a radiologist in public hospital to solve the problem. Turned out, the "foreign object" on the ultrasound was a cat poo. One star only for the first normal visit.
Ps Laughing and smiling nurses while registering a ER patient is next level of cynicism
Pps After such a reply, I think it worth to mention names of the doctors who wanted to cut my kitten for nothing, Sanni and Reeta.

It's a shame that we can't give it one star less.
On Thursday, we took our cat to the emergency room for urinary problems, where they diagnosed urinary crystals and gave him medication, which cost 450 euros.
Well, the symptoms didn't get much better, so we took the cat to another vet on Monday, where the cat was x-rayed, the urethra was catheterized (this was recommended by Mevet on Saturday when I called their 2e/min emergency phone, their price for this would have been 700 euros) and a urine sample was taken. This whole thing cost less than 200 euros at the other vet.
The other vet didn't find any of the same problems in the urine that were found at Mevet, but the diagnosis was idiopathic cystitis.
A proper cat hospital has been opened in Mevet with great fanfare, but proper care for cats is lacking there. Due to their greed for money, the cat has now been sedated twice in a week and it's not nice to look at it as an owner.

In summary, Mevet Animal Hospital made a wrong diagnosis and tried to do the next unnecessary operation at a shocking price of 700 euros. I have filed a complaint with them about this and if I cannot reach an agreement with them on compensation, the matter will of course proceed to the Consumer Ombudsman and a complaint to the Food Authority, which I may do anyway.
A wise consumer reading this will of course understand to avoid this animal hospital.
Unbelievable activity, pure fundraising without empathy for the welfare of the animal.

Addition 26.9.
Mevet Animal Hospital is unwilling to compensate for the mistakes they made and the matter will now be transferred to the authorities.

Addition to the situation on 14.10.2025, more than two years later:

The matter has finally progressed to the presentation queue at the Consumer Disputes Board, so it is completely clear that my case is not completely out of the blue because it has progressed this far.
There has been an exchange of letters here over the months and the other party has not been able to give any reasonable explanation for the mistakes they made. The same Liibalabaa gave the same answer to the Consumer Disputes Board as to me, that is, they do not feel they have made any mistakes. I also find this a bit strange that they did not even get any professional explanation there, but simply denied their own mistakes.

Now we wait to see what kind of recommendation comes from the Consumer Disputes Board and if that is the case, whether the recommendation is to pay the customer back the money, what kind of show will the other party make of it.

The cat that was poorly cared for in this place has just turned 15 and is living the life of a cat.

Addition 27.10.2025

The Consumer Disputes Board has made its decision and they do not recommend a refund. This shows how veterinary services can be performed by making assumptions "the most common diagnoses for these symptoms are usually this".
The right instance would also be the Veterinary Injury Assessment Board under the Finnish Food Authority, which is subject to a fee for the consumer.
In summary, the end result is that veterinary services seem to have a very annoying position in Finland and the consumer only has to suffer and pay for insanely expensive treatments that are not true.

Fortunately, you can still decide not to do business in places that do not work properly, but rather go to services that do not need to grind for full results for their capital investors while the quality suffers.

I also warmly recommend that others avoid all evidence-based services.
The vet is ok but otherwise a terrible place.

Expert service in internal medicine and things are handled in a way that leaves the owner feeling confident and understanding the diagnosis. We only have experience with "bigger ailments", i.e. treating triaditis in the emergency room in 2021 and now, fortunately, less acutely at Varpu's reception - the super-scary cat appreciated his gentle touch. Great new facilities and a wonderfully peaceful waiting area for cats.
I am disappointed with such poor feeding knowledge
We were very grateful for their exceptional service and very kind and professional support. Definitely the best vet clinic we have been to.
The dog had a huge tumor on her butt. The tumor was removed and now, three weeks later, she's back to normal.
Friendly and qualified staff (doctors and nurses)

Thank you to the entire staff at the Mevet Animal Hospital. The service experience is first-class and the feeling that the pet's symptoms are taken seriously and the owner is heard has committed me to being a long-term Mevet customer. When the night shift ended, I had to visit elsewhere, but whenever there was a choice, I chose Mevet. Warm thanks also for the always friendly telephone advice and for always meeting people and pets with joy.

A really great experience. A separate waiting room for cats and it's a great service for cats and owners. Snuffling is fine and the waiter is very grateful for that. This will be our new regular place❤️. Thank you very much.

After the clinic moved and partially moved to Evidensia, the prices were unbearably high and usually quite long waiting times, first to the vet and then out before "the papers are ready", but in return, really good, expert, owner-friendly veterinary service - special thanks to Susanna for years ❤️
I would consider another place for a general veterinarian, but for special situations, definitely one of the best service providers.

A big thank you to the entire staff at Mevet Animal Hospital for taking good care of my own animals❤️. I have always received really good and expert care for my dogs and cats from you and I knew when I came there that the animals would get the best possible help. When euthanasia became a topic, you have been expertly supporting me in a difficult decision♥️.
Thank you ❤️
Absolutely wonderful service every time 💚 …
Great location. New premises. Good customer service.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency room in Mevet because of a swollen paw. The dog was sedated for examination, but no examination was performed. I was pressured into euthanizing him without a proper diagnosis or clear treatment options. I felt like my dog ​​had no chance of survival, no treatment was even attempted. I am deeply shocked and will be reporting this to the authorities.
Everything works. Reminders come when new vaccinations are needed. The service is friendly and the doctors are professional. The prices are just too high here.

After the sale to Evidensia, the quality of the clinic has plummeted and at the same time the price has skyrocketed. For example, the doctor accidentally gave our dog a 10x painkiller dosage recommendation - luckily we didn't see the need for painkillers when we got home. I don't recommend this company to anyone.

There is room for improvement in the customer service of the reception staff. The employees are having fun and chatting with each other, customer service is secondary. The service could also be friendlier, thank you, please and excuse me are part of polite service. With their prices, I would expect better and more attentive service, fortunately there are other veterinary clinics.

Very satisfied with the dog's acute care needs, customer service, guidance in dog care. Dog under supervision for 1 day and on hydration and medication. Had to wait for his turn on a public holiday, but they brilliantly prioritized the urgent need for pet care.

This was the original Mevet animal hospital's operations before Evidensian bought the company.

My cat was limping and I quickly got an appointment with an orthopedist. Despite the booked time, I had to wait 40 minutes. Very nice and certainly competent staff, but obviously busy because I received quick, cursory and contradictory instructions for further treatment, but no information about the diagnosed disease and its prognosis and further treatment. I didn't even have time to ask about it or what was done at the reception, for example, whether I received painkillers, etc. The bill was absolutely freezing and I don't feel like I got value for money. Next time I'll go to Aisti where the experiences are significantly better.
Plenty of parking and absolutely wonderful service. Every person we met was so focused on their work. Thank you!

I asked separately if it was safe for my cat to wait until the next day for a regular visit for urinary problems instead of going to the emergency room, because my financial situation is tight and I wanted to save at least the emergency room fee. During the same call, I was booked in for an appointment for the next day, but without a word being mentioned that it was a specialist appointment, which would incur an additional fee. This week, we had to go for a check-up after the antibiotic course and we were seen by a different veterinarian, and this time, when I made the reservation, there was no mention of the specialist appointment, which would again incur an additional fee, although last week they apologized profusely for not mentioning it.

At no point is the customer asked if they want to go through all possible tests, but they do them (of course, some may be announced before disappearing into the examination room, but they do not check with the customer whether they agree) and then they bill them. When I made the appointment, I was told that only a urine sample would be taken at the check-up, but an ultrasound was also done and blood tests were also taken.

Last year, at least, they even asked if an ultrasound was being done and what blood tests were available, but now everything is done just to be sure without asking the owner any further. To top it all off, I waited over half an hour last week and just under 20 minutes extra for my scheduled appointment.

We needed Proplan gastrointestinal food on Sunday due to the dog's severe diarrhea that started at the beginning of the week, which we have not been able to calm down with other foods and support products so far, and the dog has had a loss of appetite. This product has worked well in similar situations and we thought we would try to calm the stomach with it before booking an appointment (or going to the emergency room). Since there are no pet supply stores nearby that sell this, we came to get it from you. The receptionist had been rude to my husband when he was shopping and pointed out to him that in the future he should come to shop any day other than Sunday (in the middle of the day), because he interrupted his nursing work when he was shopping and there were no others there. We understand if the staff is short, but I think it should be possible to buy veterinary food for acute needs during opening hours. This should at least be announced online or on the door if you are not allowed to come to shop. Customers cannot know, and no one will come to buy food on Sunday for fun. We found the treatment unpleasant, and there should be enough staff so that customers do not need to be turned away or blamed for coming to the store in such urgent matters. We would have gone to get the food from veterinarians further away if we had known, but the matter was only pointed out after payment. We have always received good care and treatment in the past, thank you for that.

my dog was taken here to get cremated, we then got her back in a week or two in a box with the urn inside. they even gave us a quote that made my whole family cry because it was so sweet. we really appreciate the work you do
. thank you!

I took my cat here to the emergency room for a broken paw and he never came home. I think the treatment was blatantly rushed, especially when it came to sedation. I wasn't even allowed to observe the treatment and I have strong suspicions about the care and quality of the treatment, even neglect. They did remember to send me a huge bill for this "treatment". When I investigated the matter, the answers took a really long time and their tone was rude. It seems like this is a place that clearly prioritizes euros, and the treatment is also about well-being. Never coming here again. I don't recommend it to anyone.

I took my rescue dog there almost two years ago with a sudden onset of severe pain in hind legs. They sedated her, palpated legs, lower back and abdomen, said that everything looks fine and prescribed pain medication. She was completely fine after a couple of days which is why I give 2 stars. However recently I took her for an x-ray in another place just to check if everything is fine with her hips, and turns out it's not fine at all. Her pelvic area and hips are completely asymmetrical as if she got hit by a car in the past. The vets in the other place said they immediately knew something is very wrong before taking the x-ray because they couldn't even straighten her legs to position them properly. I don't know how it's possible that the vet in Mevet didn't notice that something was wrong even though they thoroughly moved her legs in different directions.

That said, they took us in right away in the night and in case of extreme emergency I'd take her there again because there are no better alternatives.

Yes, the standard has dropped since Evidensia bought Mevet. Only the prices are premium now. It has become a chain-link operation. The care instructions are carelessly written and there is no way to contact the vet.

A nice big place in Pitäjänmäki, with enough parking space.
The emergency room treated my cat in less than an hour.
All the equipment is there, even the name is an animal hospital. There is also room to wait.
The only bad thing is of course the bill, as animals are being used to make money these days. I would probably use them again.
I had to go to the Sunday emergency room and got an expensive bill, but the main thing is that the friendly staff's expert work made the cat feel better again.

I don't recommend it. The people at Respa are rude and the service is bad and expensive. I spent 5 hours there and I definitely won't go again. The place has moved and nothing works in this new place.

Waiting until close to closing time and then being sent to the emergency room overnight with a layover. Last time it cost €500 to get eye drops for the cat, now you have to pay over €2000 for the observation. Terrible waste of money

In my own experience, it was a terrible scam. We took the cat to have tartar removed and it was known that some teeth would need to be removed. We asked the staff for a price estimate and were told that due to the campaign it would cost €400-500, which they felt was reasonable and that was why we didn't change hospitals. On the day of the surgery, we received a call telling us how many teeth would need to be removed, but nothing was said about the price. In the afternoon, when we went to pick up the cat, we received a bill for €1,500 because "tooth removal was not included in the campaign price". In addition, the cat's ears had been examined a few weeks earlier and samples had been taken, which found that there was nothing unusual there. However, in addition to cleaning and removing the teeth, they had taken new samples from the ears without asking, which again found that there was nothing unusual. The doctor also did not tell us how to prevent dental problems in the future.
Good experience, the price estimate was also right on the final price. Veterinarian Iina Pakarinen is a top professional.
Excellent, professional.
The offer said that two vaccines cost 49 euros. BEWARE, because it is a SCAM.

My dog ​​had surgery in Meveti. The surgery wound is opening. I start calling on Friday at 5pm and ask for access to the clinic - at 8pm it is decided that I cannot come with my dog ​​and the next morning (Sat) the clinic opens at 12pm, …

The Worst Vet Clinic Experience Ever

If you’re looking for a vet clinic that specializes in wasting your time, money, …
We went here for a cat's lameness examination. We had previously mainly gone to the Viikki Small Animal Hospital to treat bigger issues. …
